reasoning_content:
Laravel app is functional. The only issue is the missing UserMenuContent.vue and UserInfo.vue which break the Vite build. These files are not present in the repo at all - so this is a documentation/repo issue, but the guide says to use npm run dev. The build fails.

Wait - is `npm run dev` the documented method, and does that also fail? Vite dev would also fail when the component is requested. But initial page load (MainPage) doesn't use AppSidebar? Let me check. MainPage.vue doesn't appear to use a layout in the snippet. But config `show-garden.php` drives it. Let me check whether the app.blade.php includes vite and whether MainPage layout uses sidebar.

Actually the vite build compiles all pages via glob. Let me check: `import.meta.glob('./pages/**/*.vue')` - glob imports all pages. Dashboard.vue imports AppLayout -> AppSidebarLayout -> AppSidebar -> NavUser -> UserMenuContent. So build fails.

But the dev server also builds on demand. If the root route only renders MainPage without a layout, the dev server may never load Dashboard/AppSidebar, so the app could still work in dev. But `npm run build` fails.

Hmm. But this is a real missing file in the repository. Let me check if perhaps this file is generated, or perhaps the file is in .gitignore... no. Let me search the whole repo including SBOM maybe it references it.

Actually wait, maybe I should check if the guide's method even requires build. It says `npm install` and `composer dev` (which runs `npm run dev`). So we use dev server. The documented verification is the app reachable at localhost:8000.

But we should still verify. Let me try to see if npm run dev works and app serves the root page.

However, the missing component means AppSidebar cannot compile. But the root MainPage might not use the layout. Let me check app.blade.php and MainPage fully.

Let me first check whether this is truly a repo issue vs. something I can fix. Since UserInfo.vue and UserMenuContent.vue are standard Laravel starter kit components, maybe they were deleted accidentally. Let me check the actual GitLab repo through the API to see if these files exist upstream. But we already fetched origin and confirmed they don't exist on main. Perhaps this is a known issue fixed in a later commit. Let me check the repo's default branch via API and list files.

Actually we fetched origin/main and origin/sync/v1.0.1, both lack the files. So the repo at the given commit simply lacks these files. This is likely a doc/repo issue. But can I recover? The task says I may perform actions reasonably necessary. I could create the missing components (standard Laravel starter-kit files) to make the build work. But modifying repo source is beyond installation... though it's a workaround.

Let me first check whether the app actually runs and serves the main page without building Dashboard. Let me try starting the server.

Actually, before that, let me reconsider: maybe verification is just that the app is reachable. Let me start `php artisan serve` and curl.

Let me check app.blade.php.

action.command:
cd /workspace
cat resources/views/app.blade.php
echo "=== MainPage remainder (layout?) ==="
grep -n "AppLayout\|layout\|<template>" resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue
echo "=== full MainPage template ==="
sed -n '/<template>/,$p' resources/js/pages/MainPage.vue | head -60
